Muktijuddher Bijoy Natya Utsab concludes
2014-01-03T00:00:08+06:00 | Pranabesh Chakraborty, Chittagong
https://www.thedailystar.net/muktijuddher-bijoy-natya-utsab-concludes-5195

The 12-day theatre festival Muktijuddher Bijoy Natya Utsab-2013 concluded in the port city on Tuesday with the staging of two playlets by theatre troupe Angan Theatre Unit. In tandem with District Shilpakala Academy, Chittagong's leading theatre troupes' association Group Theatre Forum, organised the festival to disseminate the history of the Liberation War among today's generation. On the concluding day, Angan's presentation drew a full house at the auditorium of District Shilpakala Academy. The short play “Juta Abishkar”, based on Tagore's widely read poem, was received warmly by theatre enthusiasts. Adapted by Achintya Basu, the playlet interestingly depicted the invention of shoes. Milan Chowdhury directed the playlet while Abdus Sattar, Sanjib Barua, Sharad Mazhar, Supak Das, Shiba Mandal enacted important roles. Another playlet “Borno Biparjay” came up next. Penned by Mohit Chattopadhyay, the playlet related the story of several apathetical youths who meet with an optimist young man at an intersection of seven streets.   Sanjib Barua and Shyama Prasad Chakraborty played the main roles. Earlier in the evening, a cultural programme and a short discussion were held. Artiste Md Mostafa Kamal of “Sanjaree Shilpi Gosthi” rendered the songs. Chaired by Khaled Helal, president of Group Theatre Forum, the discussion was  addressed by Arindam Natya Samproday convener Saiful Alam Babu, Gonayon chief M Saiful Alam Chowdhury and theatre personality Golam Mortuza  Razzaque.
